title: Whole Grain Pasta with Tomato Sauce and Poultry, Ready‑to‑Heat

content.title: About
content.content: Whole grain pasta with tomato sauce and pieces of chicken meat is a ready‑to‑heat meal that can be quickly warmed in a microwave or on the stove. It contains whole‑grain pasta, a tomato sauce free from artificial colourings, and selected chicken fillet enriched with B‑vitamins.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Whole grain pasta retains more fiber and micronutrients than regular white pasta.
The tomato sauce is made from ripe tomatoes rich in lycopene, a powerful antioxidant.
Chicken is pre‑seared without breading, preserving its natural flavor.
The dish is designed for fast preparation: only 3‑5 minutes in the microwave are needed.
Packaging is made from recyclable material and bears an “Eco‑friendly” label.

items.title: High in fiber
items.content: Whole grain pasta provides dietary fiber that supports healthy digestion and blood‑sugar regulation.

items.title: Source of protein
items.content: Chicken fillet supplies high‑quality protein essential for muscle and tissue repair.

items.title: Lycopene and vitamin C
items.content: The tomato sauce delivers lycopene and vitamin C, which boost immunity and act as antioxidants.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: The meal contains vitamins B1, B2, B3 and B6, important for energy metabolism.

items.title: Low in saturated fat
items.content: Absence of butter‑based sauce and breading makes the dish lower in calories and suitable for balanced diets.

items.title: Wheat allergy
items.content: The pasta contains gluten, so individuals with celiac disease or gluten sensitivity should choose a gluten‑free alternative.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: The tomato sauce may contain a moderate amount of salt; people monitoring sodium intake should check the label.

items.title: Heat distribution
items.content: When microwaving, stir the meal halfway through to avoid hot spots.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Heat the meal in a microwave (800 W) for 3‑5 minutes, stirring halfway, or warm it in a skillet with a splash of water. Serve immediately, optionally topped with fresh herbs or grated Parmesan.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the package refrigerated at 0 °C to +4 °C. The shelf‑life is printed on the label; after opening, consume within 3‑4 days.
